name: Acute Senses
description: Reduces the difficulty of all Perception-based rolls involving a single sense (1 pt.) or all five senses (3 pt.) by -2.

name: Alcohol / Drug Tolerance
description: Allows a Stamina roll (difficulty 7) to shake off intoxication. The 1 pt. version applies to natural substances; the 2 pt. version covers lab-synthesized ones.

name: Ambidextrous
description: No penalty for using two weapons or performing tasks with the off-hand.

name: Cast-Iron Stomach
description: Character can eat nearly anything organic without ill effects.

name: Catlike Balance
description: Reduces the difficulty of physical feats involving balance (like tightrope walking) by -2.

name: Hyperflexible
description: Reduces the difficulty of rolls involving flexibility (like escaping bonds) by -2.

name: Light Sleeper
description: Character only needs four hours of sleep and wakes up instantly alert.

name: Noble Blood
description: Distinctive features mark the character as part of a powerful lineage, commanding respect or attracting enemies.

name: Enchanting Feature
description: A magnificent physical feature (eyes, voice, etc.) that provides a social edge in appropriate situations.

name: Physically Impressive
description: Adds two dice to social rolls involving intimidation due to a massive or menacing build.

name: Poison Resistance
description: Adds two dice to Stamina rolls to resist natural or synthesized toxins.

name: Poker Face
description: A deadpan expression that reveals nothing; reduces difficulty of intimidation and subterfuge rolls by -2.

name: Daredevil
description: Adds three dice to non-combat/non-magickal rolls involving high-risk physical stunts.

name: Hypersensitivity
description: Character is extraordinarily open to physical sensations (cannot be taken with Insensate to Pain).

name: Nightsight
description: Character ignores penalties for low-light conditions on visual perception rolls.

name: Huge Size
description: Character is over seven feet tall and 300 pounds; adds one Health Level and -1 difficulty to Strength rolls.

name: Insensate to Pain
description: Character ignores dice-pool penalties from wounds until death, though physical impairment remains.

name: Too Tough to Die
description: Character can soak lethal damage (but not aggravated damage).

name: Addiction
description: Compulsive need for a substance or activity.

name: Child
description: Character is legally and physically a minor, facing social, legal, and size-based obstacles.

name: Impediment
description: A physical condition (blindness, deafness, etc.) that interferes with normal functioning.

name: Aging
description: Character loses Attribute dots due to being past their prime or not yet mature.

name: Easily Intoxicated
description: Character is a lightweight; difficulty to resist drugs or booze increases by +2.

name: Repulsive Feature
description: A disconcerting physical feature adds +2 difficulty to Social rolls.

name: Profiled Appearance
description: Character has a distinctive look that makes them easy to recognize and profile.

name: Degeneration
description: Character cannot heal naturally; high levels cause constant Health loss.

name: Monstrous
description: Profound deformities result in an Appearance of 0.

name: Permanent Wound
description: Character has a lasting injury that cannot be healed, even with magick.

name: Short
description: Character is shorter than five feet and runs at half speed.

name: Horrific
description: Character is hideous to the point of causing nightmares.

name: Mayfly Curse
description: Character ages incredibly fast—one year for every two months (5 pt.) or every week (10 pt.).

name: Artistically Gifted
description: Reduces the difficulty of artistic talent rolls by -2.

name: Common Sense
description: Provides a Storyteller warning when the character is about to do something foolish.

name: Computer Aptitude
description: Reduces difficulties involving computer-based rolls by -2.

name: Concentration
description: Character ignores penalties from distractions when performing tasks.

name: Expert Driver
description: Driving-roll difficulties are reduced by -2.

name: Lightning Calculator
description: Reduces the difficulty of math-based rolls by -2.

name: Mechanical Aptitude
description: Reduces difficulties by -2 when working with mechanical gear.

name: Time Sense
description: Character possesses an intuitive internal clock.

name: Code of Honor
description: Character gains two dice to Willpower rolls when acting according to a personal ethical code.

name: Eidetic Memory
description: Character possesses a "photographic memory" for recalling details.

name: Inner Strength
description: Reduces the difficulty of Willpower rolls by -2 when struggling against overwhelming odds.

name: Natural Linguist
description: Character gains two languages for every dot of the Language Merit and bonus dice for communication.

name: Hyperfocus
description: Adds up to three extra dice to mundane extended actions when focusing without distraction.

name: Iron Will
description: Adds three dice to rolls used to resist mental influence or domination.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
description: Character ignores penalties for using Skills they don't possess.

name: Scientific Mystic / Techgnosi
description: Allows technomancers to study "mystic" magick or vice versa without extra cost.

name: Berserker
description: Character enters a battle-frenzy when injured, gaining physical boosts but losing control.

name: Judge’s Wisdom
description: Character can intuitively spot lies and hypocrisy.

name: Self-Confident
description: Character can spend Willpower for automatic success without losing the point under challenging conditions.

name: Compulsion
description: A reflexive mental tic or ritualized activity (e.g., hand-washing).

name: Impatient
description: Must make a Willpower roll to wait for others.

name: Inappropriate
description: Character frequently says or does embarrassing things, increasing social difficulties.

name: Overconfident
description: Character assumes they are the best and rarely backs down.

name: Shy
description: Social anxiety adds +2 difficulty to social rolls (+3 if center of attention).

name: Soft-Hearted
description: Character must roll Willpower to avoid intervening in suffering.

name: Amnesia
description: Character lacks memories; the Storyteller assigns "mystery flaws."

name: Icy
description: Character is callous and sociopathic, causing others to avoid them.

name: Intemperate
description: Character does everything to excess.

name: Rose-Colored Glasses
description: Character overlooks the atrocities or flaws of their faction.

name: Vengeful
description: Driven by a blood-grudge that overrides other priorities.

name: Short Fuse
description: Character must roll Willpower to avoid a violent reaction when angered.

name: Bigot
description: Character despises a specific group, viewing the world through that prejudice.

name: Chronic Depression
description: Pervasive despair affects all aspects of life, including magick.

name: Deranged
description: Character suffers from manageable (3 pt.) or crippling (5 pt.) insanity.

name: Driving Goal
description: An intense cause drives every aspect of life.

name: Feral Mind
description: Character lacks human social development, behaving animalistically.

name: Flashbacks
description: Traumatic memories manifest as current reality.

name: Hatred
description: Character despises a specific group and will harm them if possible.

name: Lifesaver
description: Character has a moral imperative to save all lives.

name: Ability Deficit
description: Subtracts five points from an Ability category and limits starting dots to three.

name: Loyalty
description: Two-die bonus to resist being turned against a specific cause or person.

name: Pitiable
description: Character inspires care; reduces difficulty to get help but harder to intimidate.

name: Prestigious Mentor
description: Character's teacher has an influential reputation.

name: Regal Bearing
description: Radiant dignity reduces difficulty of social rolls to make an impression by -2.

name: Unobtrusive
description: People tend to forget the character's presence; +2 difficulty to describe them.

name: Animal Magnetism
description: Primal sex appeal reduces difficulty on seduction rolls by -2.

name: Confidence
description: Unshakable self-assurance adds two dice to social rolls used to impress.

name: Family Support
description: Family provides emotional (1 pt.), status (2 pt.), or string-pulling (3 pt.) aid.

name: Favor
description: A more powerful party owes the character a minor to life-debt boon.

name: Hideaway / Safehouse
description: Character owns a secure location unknown to enemies.

name: Natural Leader
description: Adds two dice to Leadership rolls.

name: Officially Dead
description: Authorities believe character is deceased.

name: Perfect Liar
description: Lacks "tells"; reduces difficulty of deception rolls by -2.

name: Prestige
description: Honored status in a sect adds three dice to social influence rolls.

name: Property
description: Ownership of a useful location like a house or business.

name: Research Grant
description: Institutional stipend provides character with living expenses.

name: Sanctity
description: Character projects innocence even if guilty.

name: Secret Code Language
description: Knowledge of exclusive initiatory languages.

name: Socially Networked
description: Deep connections on social media provide quick info.

name: Subculture Insider
description: Deep knowledge of a specific scene (Goth, military, etc.).

name: Dark Triad
description: Character possesses narcissistic, Machiavellian, or psychopathic traits that aid manipulation.

name: Local Hero
description: Character is beloved by local Sleepers, providing constant aid.

name: Noted Messenger
description: Emissary status grants deference even from enemies.

name: Rising Star
description: Character is an up-and-coming luminary.

name: Ties
description: Deep connections to mundane groups like Police or Mafia.

name: Master of Red Tape
description: Bureaucracy savant reduces difficulty of system-based rolls by -2.

name: True Love
description: Unshakable bond provides a temporary point of Willpower in crises.

name: Blacklisted
description: Character is a pariah among a segment of the Masses.

name: Conflicting Loyalties
description: Loyalties to two at-odds parties cause constant crises.

name: Conniver
description: Reputation for treachery makes trust difficult.

name: Discredited
description: Professional name is "mud," adding +2 to social difficulties.

name: Esoteric Discourse / Technobabbler
description: Obsessive jargon adds +1/+2 difficulty to social rolls.

name: Insane / Infamous Mentor
description: Association with a problematic mentor fouls up relations.

name: Mistaken Identity
description: People mistake character for someone else, usually someone troublesome.

name: New Kid
description: Recently Awakened status adds +2 difficulty to rolls with experienced mages.

name: Sect Enmity
description: Character has angered an entire sect within their larger group.

name: Sympathizer
description: Expressing sympathy for an enemy faction makes character unpopular.

name: Debts
description: Character owes creditors from $10k (1 pt.) to over $500k (5 pt.).

name: Enemy
description: Targeted by a minor (1 pt.) to powerful (5 pt.) opponent.

name: Infamy
description: Recognized and disliked by the Masses.

name: Diabolical Mentor
description: Trained by a malevolent being like a Nephandus.

name: Dogmatic
description: Strong beliefs make character abrasive toward others.

name: Failure
description: Character is a laughingstock for blowing a high-profile job.

name: Gullible
description: Character believes everything and reposts unchecked memes; -3 dice to penetrate lies.

name: Old Flame
description: A former lover now works for the enemy and knows the character's weak spots.

name: Troublemaker
description: Character projects guilt and is blamed for problems even when innocent.

name: Construct
description: Lab-born character suffers social alienation from humans.

name: Narc
description: Shunned as an informer, adding +1 difficulty to social rolls.

name: Notoriety
description: Bad reputation among mages adds +2 difficulty to social rolls.

name: Rotten Liar
description: Unable to tell credible untruths; adds +2 difficulty to deception.

name: Ward
description: Character is responsible for an unAwakened person who requires protection.

name: Mr. Red Tape
description: Hated by bureaucracy; adding +2 difficulty to system rolls.

name: Overextended
description: Character has tried to do too much, resulting in constant strain.

name: Probationary Member
description: Defector from a rival group is expected to turn at any time.

name: Rogue
description: A "loose cannon" acting outside faction rules.

name: Witch-Hunted
description: Identity is exposed, and mundane groups want them dead.

name: Fifth Degree
description: Character has outlived their usefulness to the Technocracy and is set to fall.

name: Burning Aura
description: Aura pulsates with bright power, adding -1 difficulty to certain magickal acts but making them easy to spot.

name: Green Thumb
description: Plants flourish; reduces difficulty of Arete rolls involving vegetation by -1.

name: Bardic Gift
description: Character's Art or Expression possesses a touch of minor enchantment.

name: Circumspect Avatar
description: Insights from the Avatar come through everyday events rather than visions.

name: Faerie Affinity
description: Fae beings favor the character, providing a social bonus with changelings.

name: Medium
description: Character communicates with ghosts without Spirit magick.

name: Unaging
description: Character does not age physically.

name: Celestial Affinity
description: Character is in tune with astrological alignments.

name: Cloak of the Seasons
description: Character is untouched by extremes of temperature and climate.

name: Cyclic Magick
description: Magickal power waxes and wanes with a specific natural cycle (e.g., lunar).

name: Danger Sense
description: Reduces difficulty of Alertness rolls to avoid ambushes by -2.

name: Hands of Daedalus
description: Innate crafting proficiency adds two dice to Crafts rolls.

name: Lucky
description: Character can re-roll a failed die roll three times per story.

name: Manifest Avatar
description: Avatar is a real, character-like presence in daily life.

name: Mark of Favor
description: Character is blessed by a potent spirit or god.

name: Natural Channel
description: Gauntlet difficulty is reduced by -1 for the character.

name: Natural Shapeshifter
description: Character can shift physical forms with ease (requires Life 4).

name: Oracular Ability
description: Provides intuitive glimpses of the past or future.

name: Parlor Trick
description: Character can perform minor, coincidental metaphysical effects without Arete rolls.

name: Spirit Magnet
description: Spirits are drawn to the character in varying numbers/potency.

name: Spirit Mentor
description: A spirit teacher provides guidance and knowledge.

name: Supernatural Companion
description: Character is accompanied by a spirit, ghost, or mythic creature.

name: Stormwarden / Quantum Voyager
description: Character is immune to the Avatar Storm.

name: Deathwalker
description: Character can step into the Low Umbra with Spirit 3; aura is pale like death.

name: Fae Blood
description: Character is Kinain; low banality and permanently enchanted.

name: Shapechanger Kin
description: Related to were-breeds; immune to Delirium.

name: Twin Souls
description: Character shares a soul with another person; they sense each other’s presence.

name: Umbral Affinity
description: Character feels at home in the Umbra; Gauntlet difficulties reduced by -1.

name: Unbondable
description: Immune to blood bonds and resistant to mental domination.

name: Ghoul
description: Consumed vampire blood provides vitality but incurs addiction.

name: Clear Sighted
description: Character sees through illusions and shapeshifting automatically.

name: “Immortal”
description: Character cannot die except via a specific "special doom."

name: Inner Knight
description: Heroic higher purpose grants boosts in hopeless crises.

name: Legendary Attributes
description: Allows an Attribute to be raised to 6 dots.

name: Powerful Ally
description: Character has badass friends like vampire lords or faerie nobles.

name: Shattered Avatar
description: Allows Avatar Background to be raised after character creation.

name: Spark of Life
description: Lethal injuries heal as bashing; aggravated heal faster.

name: Guardian Angel
description: A powerful spirit protects the character from mortal harm.

name: Nine Lives
description: Character can cheat death nine times, forcing re-rolls.

name: Sphere Natural
description: Innate proficiency in one Sphere; costs 70% exp.

name: Avatar Companion
description: A companion sharing part of the character's soul follows them through incarnations.

name: Dual Affiliation
description: Familiar with focuses and connections of two different Awakened groups.

name: Nephilim / Laham
description: Character is half-divine/demonic; powerful but cursed.

name: True Faith
description: Character channels divine power for miraculous feats.

name: Anachronism
description: Character is from a different time; high levels add +3 difficulty to modern knowledge.

name: Apprentice
description: Character is training an often troublesome student.

name: The Bard’s Tongue
description: Character speaks the truth about people, whether they want to or not.

name: Cast No Shadow or Reflection
description: Character lacks a shadow or reflection, unnerving others.

name: Cursed
description: Supernatural misfortune ranging from quirks to pervasive failure.

name: Devil’s Mark
description: A deformation allows others to draw Quintessence from the character.

name: Echoes
description: Reality ripples (e.g., touch of frost) from the character's nature.

name: Paranormal Prohibition or Imperative
description: Character must or must not do something (geas).

name: Gremlin
description: A troublesome spirit sabotages the character's surroundings.

name: Locked Vidare
description: Character views the Penumbra through a single, unchangeable metaphorical lens.

name: Strangeness
description: Character's presence causes subtle, inexplicable oddities.

name: Throwback
description: Character possesses traits of a past incarnation.

name: Uncanny
description: Character is remarkably memorable and stands out.

name: Vulnerability
description: Weakened or killed by contact with a rare or common substance (e.g., silver).

name: Bizarre Hunger
description: Character must eat weird/illegal substances.

name: Blood-Hungry Soul
description: Past-life addiction to vampire blood.

name: Crucial Component
description: Magick requires a specific, hard-to-procure instrument.

name: Faulty Enhancements
description: Cybernetic hardware malfunctions, failing at critical times.

name: Jinx / Infernal Contraption
description: Cursed Wonder backfires or attracts spirits.

name: Permanent Paradox Flaw
description: A lasting Paradox Flaw that is part of daily life.

name: Branded
description: Visible mark of shame from a faction punishment.

name: Demented Eidolon
description: A mad heretical voice in the character's head.

name: Haunted
description: Plagued by a ghost that harasses the living.

name: Primal Marks
description: Unpleasant marks from a god (e.g., stigmata).

name: Oathbreaker
description: Known as faithless after breaking a significant oath.

name: Prone to Quiet
description: Stress automatically sends character into metaphysical Quiet.

name: Beast Within
description: Violent temper subject to rage-frenzy.

name: Blood Magick
description: Spellcasting requires an injurious amount of character's own blood.

name: Bound
description: Character is blood-bound or spiritually enslaved to another.

name: Dark Fate
description: Character is doomed to a specific, awful death.

name: Faithless
description: Belief that god cut off character from magick; Spheres stuck at Rank 1.

name: Immortal Enemy
description: Eternal grudge with a vampire elder or demon.

name: Psychic Vampire
description: Character drains life force/Quintessence from others.

name: Bedeviled
description: A mysterious power fucks with the character's life.

name: Sphere Inept
description: Exceptionally difficult to learn or use one specific Sphere.

name: Phylactery
description: Magick/soul resides in an external portable object.

name: Taint of Corruption
description: Nephandic soul from a previous incarnation urges character to Fall.

name: Shadow Appeal
description: Insights gained through the Caul reduce the difficulty of shadow-directed social manipulation by two, including beyond the usual modifier limit.
reviewNote: Verified against the supplied PDF; source eligibility still applies.
eligibility: Caul-initiated Fallen only unless the Storyteller explicitly rules otherwise.

name: Innocuous Aura
description: The aura lacks the usual visible traces of Qlippothic passage; this conceals origin, not every emotional state.
reviewNote: Verified against the supplied PDF; source eligibility still applies.
eligibility: Caul-initiated Fallen only unless the Storyteller explicitly rules otherwise.

name: Abyssal Mastery
description: Survive deep space and the Deep Umbra without life support; travel still requires a means of movement. Spirit 5 permits escape to an already attained Qlipha.
reviewNote: Verified against the supplied PDF; source eligibility still applies.
eligibility: Caul-initiated Fallen only unless the Storyteller explicitly rules otherwise.

name: Saint of the Pit
description: Infernal reputation reduces relevant social difficulties by three against lesser malign entities. The most powerful entities are unaffected.
reviewNote: Verified against the supplied PDF; source eligibility still applies.
eligibility: Caul-initiated Fallen only unless the Storyteller explicitly rules otherwise.

name: Qlippothic Radiance
description: Threads of anti-light in aura make others uncomfortable.

name: Spectral Presence
description: A largely Penumbral existence makes physical interaction require Storyteller Willpower rolls and continued temporary Willpower expenditure.
reviewNote: Verified against the supplied PDF; source eligibility still applies.
eligibility: Caul-initiated Fallen only unless the Storyteller explicitly rules otherwise.

name: Abyssal Lunatic
description: Supernatural disintegration of coherent thought makes this character unsuitable for ordinary player use. Storyteller characters only.
reviewNote: Verified against the supplied PDF; source eligibility still applies.
eligibility: Caul-initiated Fallen only unless the Storyteller explicitly rules otherwise.

name: Widderslainte, or Taint of Corruption
description: Born with a Nephandic soul, struggling with the urge to Fall.

name: Alpha
description: Reduces social difficulties for natural leaders.

name: My Master is My Slave
description: Dependent possesses leverage to ruin their "master."

name: Dominance
description: Commanded demeanor adds three dice to social interaction.

name: Alien Impression
description: Visible inhuman features freak people out.

name: Animal
description: Literal animal cannot use human tools.

name: Beta
description: Born to follow and support leaders.

name: Broken
description: Will is trashed; character must obey a master.

name: Omega
description: Bottom of the social hierarchy; suffers abuse.

name: Power Source
description: Takes unsoakable damage outside home Reality Zone.

name: Thaumivore
description: Must consume Quintessence to survive.

name: Unbelief
description: Bygone nature causes Paradox-like injury on Earth.

name: Ungainly Fingers
description: Lacks fine manual dexterity.

name: Weak Spot
description: A specific spot bypasses all armor/soak.

name: Aura
description: Character possesses a distinct, noticeable aura that cannot be hidden.
